VCASS Notifications

Know when your vehicle needs your attention. Most of the time, we never even know our vehicle alarm is going off. Without a notification, a criminal may have time to continue what they’re doing before you even know there’s a problem.

VCASS brings the event to you.

VCASS is designed to notify you when your vehicle needs your attention.

Whether you’re at work, at home, or asleep, the notification gives you a heads-up that something is happening at your vehicle.

That gives you the opportunity to check the situation and contact the authorities if necessary.

Hear it or not — you’ll know.
